decision: Owner D32-D55 and implementation plan 11.1.1. Retire only superseded LP/Open/capped behaviors after mapping to funded-family assertions or their removal decision. Native decimal reserve-route integration remains separate.
new_assertion_validation: checkpoint-388-run.json: complete focused suite, 388 tests / 47 suites pass after separate build, including epoch-on-unstake and default/config checks.
